implementationScope: package-only progressive JFIF 4:2:0 incremental session with semantic-unit marker streaming, exact-MCU transport, cadence-aware output lifetime and render-only arena separation

cases.mechanismPressure: every byte boundary and every completed-scan render; RGB persists between scans but IDCT/smoothing/row scratch must exist only during each render
995328-byte RGB and 17088-byte renderer arena are absent between scans; finish-only render recomposes persistent state, output and render scratch without MCU rollback coexistence
transactional restart suspension retains only persistent coefficient/control state; output and renderer arena appear only at finish

requiredInvariants: All v5 transport, marker-streaming, source-authority, output-cadence and transactional-MCU invariants remain unchanged.

The historical StatePlan total is decomposed without changing one-shot output semantics: persistentStateBytes = coefficientStateBytes + 3072 aligned persistent control bytes; renderScratchBytes = rowStateBytes + 384 fixed IDCT/smoothing bytes; their sum equals totalStateBytes exactly.

Persistent StateArena owns coefficients, bound component quantization, progression state, Huffman state and raw quantization-source state only. It does not own IDCT workspace, smoothing coefficients or reconstruction row/context strips.

RenderArena is allocated only while one preview/final render executes and contains exactly the 384-byte fixed render scratch plus the source-derived rowStateBytes. It is released before returning to suspended entropy state.

For every-completed-scan cadence, retainedBetweenCalls is transport + persistent state + one reusable RGB backing. operationPeak is max(SOF2 transition, retained+rollback scratch, retained+render scratch).

For final-only cadence, retainedBetweenCalls is transport + persistent state only. operationPeak is max(SOF2 transition, retained+rollback scratch, retained+final RGB+render scratch). RGB and render scratch never coexist with MCU rollback.

The 576x576 retained source must report persistentStateByteCount 998400 and renderScratchByteCount 17088, so pre-finish final-only retained state is 998814 bytes while final render peak remains 2011230 bytes.

The 23x13 source must report persistentStateByteCount 4608 and renderScratchByteCount 2752; every-preview retained state and peak are lower than v5 while final pixels and preview backing identity remain unchanged.
Terminal finish/cancel/fatal failure still publishes zero codec-owned retained/operation/output state.
This profile does not qualify public DecodedImage color representation, non-JFIF semantics, embedded ICC, other sampling modes, physical RSS, allocator headers or perceptual reconstruction quality.
